definition: The fixed joint interpretation keeps boundaryRival.ontic and its separately specified concrete and grounds predicates unchanged. Its universal-access Bool worlds have Bool×Bool candidates, all stipulated concrete; candidate (h,b) exists exactly at world h. A necessary concrete individual would be concrete and present at false and every accessible world, which none is. Grounding at a world relates its existing false-tagged root to its existing true-tagged child, leaving the contingent root without an existing concrete ground. The new Model.explains adds a token intrinsic x exactly when x exists, without adding any grounding edge or certifying that token sufficient. JointWitness conjoins soundness, all-world existence-PSR, no necessary concrete individual, and failure of grounding every contingent actual concrete individual at false.
note: A single analyst-defined compatibility expansion, not a general equivalence of explanation and grounding and not a metaphysical possibility assertion. Intrinsic is a reason tag only.
